name: @equin/plugin-packages-heap-pacing
description: Heap pacing for heavy bun processes: pacedHeapEnv(env) sets BUN_JSC_forceRAMSize to HEAVY_PROCESS_RAM_BYTES (4 GB) unless the env already names one, so JavaScriptCore grows a multi-GB heap by ~1.3x before collecting instead of the ~2.7x it allows against the machine's whole RAM. Applied where TypeScript-program processes start (the type-check worker and its batches, ./equin run scripts) and inherited by their children.
